title: feat(rendering): adaptive WebGL quality contract (#337)
body:
Wraps up #337 to establish an adaptive WebGL quality contract.

### What changed
- Added `deriveRendererContextOptions()` pure function mapping `low`/`medium`/`high`/`ultra` quality presets to DPR cap, antialiasing, shadow mode/size, tone mapping, and color space.
- Applied options at Canvas creation in `App.tsx` with a quality-based remount key.
- Gated `preserveDrawingBuffer` to screenshot/capture URLs only via `isVisualCaptureMode()`.
- Added WebGL context-loss recovery toast + Canvas epoch remount.
- Added unit tests for the matrix, context-loss, and rendering configuration.
- Documented the quality matrix in `RENDERER.md`.
- `createGameRenderer` still always returns `THREE.WebGLRenderer`.

### Follow-ups (deferred)
- Wire `getRendererShadowMapSize()` into `SceneLighting` so renderer contract and per-light map sizes share one source.
- Expose current DPR/shadow mode in DebugPanel diagnostics.
- Consider remounting Canvas when settings hydration completes if persisted quality differs from initial render.

### Verification
- `pnpm typecheck`: Passed
- `pnpm test`: Passed
- `pnpm build`: Passed
- `pnpm test:visual-smoke`: `00_start_menu` screenshot validation passed (top-down tests are best effort and skip when UI isn't ready).
